The number moves DOWN, 12038 to 12007, and the direction is what makes this bankable. The gate is --mode no-increase, so a decrease passes silently and banking TIGHTENS the floor rather than absorbing anything. CLAUDE.md section 4's entry on this gate cautions against banking, and that caution is about the opposite direction: it was written when the tree read 12061 against a floor of 12059, where banking would have recorded another commit's two lines as permanent debt. That entry is two bankings stale -- it describes a floor of 12059 and the file has said 12038 since.

Upstream's; our side contributed nothing. At origin/19.0-marin, which is HEAD~2 because this sync rebased two local commits onto origin rather than replaying the branch, it also reads 12007.

The offender that entry names is still present and is NOT hidden by this bank: addons/hr/migrations/1.5.0/pre-migrate_employee_tags.py::migrate is 152 lines, 62 of the 12007. It is a one-shot data migration and shortening it remains its author's call.

Measured in a clean detached worktree, with --top 0: the default listing truncates, and a grep against the truncated form reports that offender ABSENT when it is present. That mistake was made and caught here.
